echoParts: And how are they to preach
of those who preach the good news!'
verseText: And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, 'How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news!'
meaning: People need to believe the good news of Jesus to be saved. That means it's our job to tell others about Jesus. It's a beautiful thing when we use our feet to go and tell others about Jesus.
